errors.restaurant_suspended: This restaurant's account is suspended. Please contact Chalai support.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.validation_failed: Some details aren't right. Check and try again.
errors.unauthorized: You were logged out. Please log in again.
errors.not_found: That was already removed. The page is up to date now.
errors.table_busy: That table already has an open order.
errors.item_unavailable: A dish in this order just sold out. Remove it and send again.

errors.has_payments: This order has payments, so it can't be cancelled.

errors.payment_too_much: That's more than the amount due.

login.title: Staff log in
login.body: Waiters, cashiers, managers, kitchen and owners log in here.
login.help: Forgot your password? Ask the owner to reset it.

password.title: Choose your own password
password.body: Welcome, {name}. Your password was temporary: pick one only you know.

noPlan.title: Your plan doesn't include the POS
noPlan.body: The cashier, waiter and kitchen screens come with the Service and Complete plans. Ask the owner to upgrade from the Chalai owner app, or contact Chalai support.
noPlan.suspendedBody: The account is on hold. The owner can contact Chalai support to turn it back on.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The page couldn't load. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.notFoundBody: That order or page doesn't exist any more.

floor.title: Floor
floor.paidTable: Order #{number} is paid. Table {table} is free now.
floor.noTables: No tables yet. The owner adds tables in the Chalai owner app.

order.title: Order #{number}
order.billRequested: The guest asked for the bill at {time}.
order.pendingTitle: {n, plural, one {QR order waiting for you} other {# QR orders waiting for you}}
order.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. Kitchen closed for this dish
order.noRounds: Nothing ordered yet. Tap Add items.
order.cancelOrderBody: Only for orders opened by mistake or guests who left. The table becomes free.
order.noRoundsPicker: Nothing ordered yet. Pick dishes from the menu.

override.title: Manager approval
override.body: A manager or the owner types their username and password here.

bill.title: Bill #{number}
bill.heading: Bill · {table}
bill.alreadyPaid: This order is paid and closed.
bill.pendingRounds: A QR order is waiting for approval.
bill.discountBody: In taka or percent. Replaces any earlier discount; 0 removes it.
bill.amountHint: Due: {due}. Less than this records a part payment.

picker.title: Add items
picker.heading: Add to {table} · #{number}
picker.count: {n, plural, =0 {Nothing added} one {# item} other {# items}}
picker.hint: Tap a dish to add it

menu.title: Menu availability
menu.body: {n, plural, =0 {Everything is available.} one {# dish is sold out.} other {# dishes are sold out.}} Tap to change; guests and waiters see it at once.
menu.empty: No dishes yet. The owner adds the menu in the Chalai owner app.

toast.opened: Order opened. Add the first dishes.
toast.approved: Approved and sent to the kitchen.
toast.rejected: QR order rejected. The guest sees why.
toast.paidTable: Order #{number} is paid. Table {table} is free now.
toast.guestOrder: Table {table} sent a QR order. Tap the table to approve it.

demo.title: Chalai POS demo
demo.body: A sample restaurant that lives only in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere, so try anything. Open the kitchen screen in a second tab to watch orders move.
demo.guestOrderHint: As if a guest scanned a table's QR code and ordered from their phone.
demo.loginBody: Tap a role to look around. Or type its username (manager, cashier, waiter or kitchen) and the password {password}.
